reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many different callees including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these callees have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow internally but requests queue before frontend processes them.
CPU usage of frontend is 0.007 cores out of 0.010 cores limit, which is 72% of its CPU limit, indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion.
Pod health shows frontend pod was recreated 331 seconds ago due to a recent configuration change reducing CPU limit from 200m to 10m, likely causing the resource exhaustion.
No errors are reported on frontend or its callees, consistent with latency caused by resource exhaustion rather than failures.
